name: 94134 · San Francisco, CA
findings: ZIP 94134 (San Francisco) has 84 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94134 (San Francisco) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 94134 (San Francisco) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 21% of all organizations here have no identified type.
